Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno; molecule_dictionary to docs via compound_records on molregno and doc_id. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
